protocol.teacher: Archived independently reward-trained Strategy B controllers 11013/11014
protocol.receiver: v3 matched-stream post-sensory forced codes, 12 repeats per cue/branch; all gates required
protocol.student: cue heads, own reward alpha .03, decoded-action softmax imitation alpha .03, epsilon .20
protocol.training: 12*24 Strategy B, new predetermined opponent seeds, keyed streams
protocol.evaluation: 72 disconnected frozen rounds, new predetermined opponent seeds
protocol.sourceGate: trained >=70% winning preference per cue; scrambled <=60% per cue; all actions; >=50% shuffle changed
protocol.transmissionGate: >=99% exact decoded targets and no off-code DN counts
protocol.similarityBand: neural versus digital early mean and final differences each within +/-2 wins/72
protocol.teacherInformationGate: neural early mean >=4 wins/72 above both silent and scrambled for both students
